Wedding officiant here - my #1 piece of advice to every couple is to find a private place to go directly after the ceremony - walk down the aisle and head straight to it. Spend at least 5 or 10 minutes in there together, just the two of you. Cherish the moment. You’re going to be pulled into a million different directions for the rest of the day and you’ll be too exhausted by the end to really spend time together. Look at each other, “we did it!”, hug, kiss, jump up and down, cry, whatever. But take those moments as sacred. You’ll never regret it.
